command: $d=Get-Content '.state\timeline\timeline-store.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $anchor='incident:inc-20260906-2017-eest-live-mcp-stack-disruption-recurrence'; $case=$d.continuity_graph.cases | Where-Object { $_.anchors -contains $anchor }; if($case){'TIMELINE_CASE';$case | Select-Object case_id,severity,traits,latest_event_at,latest_title,source_families,evidence_forms | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6}else{'INCIDENT_CASE_NOT_FOUND'}; $b=Get-Content '.state\timeline\bootstrap-memory-overview.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; 'BOOTSTRAP_MATCHES'; $items=@(); foreach($w in $b.overview.timeline_snapshots.windows){ $items += @($w.case_examples); $items += @($w.highlights) }; $items | Where-Object { $_.title -match 'recurring live MCP stack disruption|live MCP stack disruption during prohibited replacement' } | Select-Object -Unique id,case_id,severity,traits,at,title,source | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
